opening.argument: The responding speaker explicitly says the point of the interaction was to waste the caller’s time, framing the questionable support exchange as scam-baiting rather than an endorsed service. The caller claims an Apple software-update problem and asks for updating codes, then describes a $100 amount as refundable and requests the card’s scratch-off code. Those requests are the conduct being tested in the exchange. The apparent Apple profile does not establish that the creator is affiliated with or endorses Apple; the record supports a scam-baiting interaction, not a claim that anyone lost money or that the requested code was provided.
